purpose: Path optimizer. Among actions the SHIELD (constraints.json) leaves feasible, choose the CHEAPEST action with positive expected value; escalate across ticks; stop on EV-floor or horizon. Sits INSIDE the shield and never re-enables a blocked action.

meta.objective: maximize E[recovered_paise] - retry_cost - comms_cost, subject to constraints.json. The churn-cost term is intentionally OMITTED: it is counterfactual and unmeasurable now (see spikes/constraint-path-optimization README feasibility section). Harassment is bounded structurally by the comms frequency/gap constraints in the shield, not by a cost term.
meta.selection_rule_detail: EV(a) = p_recover(decline_class, a, attempt_index) * amount_paise - cost_paise(a). Keep feasible actions with EV>0 not already in case.tiers_attempted. Pick the CHEAPEST (lowest tier order). Not argmax-EV: cost order is a decision we trust; the magnitude of p_recover is not. Escalate to the next tier only on a later tick after the cheaper tier failed.
meta.ev_floor_stop: If no feasible action has p_recover*amount_paise > cost_paise, STOP the case (status stopped_ev).
meta.attempt_index: 0-based count of prior money-moving attempts for money-moving actions, or prior touches of that channel for contact actions. Clamp to last element of the prior array.
meta.provenance: EVERY p_recover value below is a CONSERVATIVE PRIOR with validated:false. These are placeholders to make the arithmetic runnable, NOT measured performance. Replace cell-by-cell with recovered/attempted from audit data once a cell reaches min_n. DO NOT quote these as results.

tiers.note: Gateway-owned retry (T+1/2/3). Free. Preferred when retry_owner=gateway.
Merchant-owned retry. Executing it = send pre-debit notice now, debit at +24h. Scheme re-presentment risk bounded by the shield's network cap.
Transactional email. Cheap, TRAI-exempt, survives DND/quiet-hours.
WhatsApp utility template. Subject to DND, quiet-hours, freq caps in shield.
Customer-action request (re-auth / AFA). The ONLY progress path when shield returns require_action. Transactional: survives DND-unknown.
Ops review. Clears EV floor only for high-value cases.

tier_fields.max_uses: Max times this tier may be chosen per case. Escalation moves to the next tier once exhausted or after each failed use.
tier_fields.latency_hours: How long after executing before an outcome is expected; sets case.next_eligible_at (the next tick).

priors._comment: p_recover[decline_class][action] = array indexed by attempt_index (clamped). validated:false. Conservative by construction.
priors._pre_failure_comment: Detector-originated recurring classes (decline_family=pre_failure). 'Recovery' = the scheduled charge succeeds. Money-moving is shield-blocked. validated:false.
priors._non_recurring_comment: Checkout + receivables domains. No mandate; contact-only. validated:false.

defaults.note: If (decline_class, action) has no prior, use prior_when_missing so the arithmetic still runs but the cell is flagged for instrumentation.
